answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a calm lagoon: still and untested. Standing grows through a voyage. A trellis of verified contributions supports the vine of trust. Established identities rest like ivory, rare and durable from years of checked labor. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure rather than key count, synthetic accounts drift in the lagoon while genuine contributors stand firm.
